messages:
Hana K.: Quick sync: customer A (healthcare) wants an "optimize" pilot focusing on batching + quant recommendations + eval alerts. They need a concrete checklist for pilot gating. Can we outline minimum scope and success metrics? :thinking_face:
Mike L.: For batching: start with per-model perf baseline + an recommended batch size table. Eg, sampling: `batch=8` for Llama-2-13B-8q on A100, latency < 120ms p95.
Sara R.: Quant recs: we should include a compatibility matrix (float16, 8-bit, 4-bit) + expected quality delta vs baseline and example prompts to validate. Also include a simple `quality_threshold` param for eval-triggered alerts.
Devon P.: From SE side, customer will expect a one-command config to enable the recommendations in pilot. Proposal: `redwood optimize apply --preset pilot-custA --dry-run` that outputs suggested batching, caching rules, and quant profile.
Olivia (CSE): They asked for canary behavior — if recommendations regress quality, auto-fallback to baseline. Need rollout policy in docs. Also they want per-route cost delta estimate before applying.
Hana K.: Good notes. For pilot gating I propose: (1) reproducible baseline perf (latency, cost, quality) (2) recommendations applied in dry-run and one small canary (3) no >2% quality degradation on eval suite, and (4) cost improvement >= 15% or latency improvement >= 20% for the bulk of traffic. Thoughts?
Mike L.: stats nit: 2% quality delta is tight for some models with 4-bit quant. Maybe allow 3% for aggressive quant, but require a manual signoff. We can automate the eval check with existing eval harness.
Sara R.: Agree. Suggest adding: show per-prompt category breakdown (e.g., short prompts vs long context) — some quantizations impact long-context completions more. Add `eval_alerts` that trigger on both absolute delta and drift over time.
Devon P.: Implementation notes: will need an `optimize-reports` artifact with: recommended_profile.json, perf_baseline.csv, eval_results.json. We can store these in the customer's RBAC-restricted project.
Hana K.: Launch criteria (MVP pilot): docs + one-click dry-run + canary tooling + alerts wired to their Slack + cost/latency delta dashboard. Timeline: 3 sprints for an SE-facing MVP?
Olivia (CSE): Customer needs timeline inside next 6 weeks. Can we compress by shipping a docs-first pilot: run recommendations offline, share report, manual apply by SE, then automation later?
Mike L.: We can do docs-first + manual apply in 3 weeks if eng focuses on report generation and eval automation. Full automation (apply + rollback) is another 3-4 weeks.
Hana K.: Ok let's propose staged pilot: Stage 0: offline report + eval (deliverable week 2). Stage 1: dry-run UI + artifact + manual apply (week 4). Stage 2: automated apply + canary + alerts (week 8). If customer signs early we can prioritize stages.
Devon P.: One ask from ops: include a simple small-scale synthetic load test to validate batching benefits before canary. I can add a small script for that.
Sara R.: I'll draft the eval suite & thresholds. Mike can surface perf baselines. Hana, I'll add the per-model compatibility notes.
Hana K.: Perfect. I'll draft the pilot gating doc and share as PR. assign@hana to do initial draft, due in 48h. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: `optimize/report-gen` job queued to run nightly on customer-A project.
